game: LA @ TEN, 2025-09-14 13:00 ET, outdoors, TEN +5.5, total 41.5

script.base: LA is a 5.5-point road favorite in a 41.5 outdoor game (implied LA 23.5, TEN 18). Base flow is a modest LA lead, slower pace, and a run lean: Kyren Williams (18 carries, 66 yards in the only week on file) works a Titans run defense that allowed 5.46 YPC and four 10-plus runs and is without DT T'Vondre Sweat, while Tennessee's 18-point offense — already -1.10 EPA/dropback when blitzed, now with LT JC Latham out — stalls and has to throw once behind.
script.flip1: The +5.5 home dog hangs around and clocks it with Tony Pollard (18/60 week 1), so LA cannot run the lead out; Stafford stays on Puka Nacua (11 targets, 130 yards, 98 air) and Davante Adams (8/51/70 air) and Kyren's carry count dies.
script.flip2: LA jumps ahead early, runs the clock, and Nacua/Adams stall under those week-1 ceilings, while Tennessee abandons Pollard into a 35% LA blitz that already produced -1.10 EPA/dropback.

injury_fallout: Pre-game nflverse report only; inactives ~90 minutes out are not in the pack. TEN T JC Latham Out (hip): Titans pass pro and left-side run lose their starter, so Pollard efficiency is at risk and quick throws (Chig Okonkwo 4 targets/19 yards, Gunnar Helm 2/16) gain relative to deep shots (Calvin Ridley 8/27 on 69 air, Elic Ayomanor 7/13 on 133 air). TEN S Kevin Winston Jr. Doubtful (hamstring): deep shots to Nacua/Adams gain if he sits; no replacement safety is named. TEN RB Kalel Mullings Doubtful (ankle): not in the week-1 rusher list, so the carry vacuum looks empty — Pollard already had 18 carries and Julius Chestnut only 2/2; do not treat Chestnut as a promoted starter. LA TE Colby Parkinson Doubtful (shoulder): next man is Davis Allen (2 targets, 13 yards) if Parkinson sits; Parkinson's own week-1 line was 2 targets for -6, so the bump is small and unconfirmed. LA G Steve Avila Doubtful (ankle): skill framework says pressure up, rush efficiency down, more quick throws — a direct hit to Kyren's efficiency and a small bump to RB/TE catches (week 1 those catches were Corum 1/14 and Allen 2/13, not Kyren 2/3). The usable overlap is Kyren's carries into a Sweat-less 5.46 YPC run defense, and Pollard's carries dying in a negative script rather than into a shutdown front.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Kyren went under 66.5 because Avila sat, Tennessee loaded the box on a one-game 3.67 YPC back, and the Sweat absence was already in a soft 5.46 YPC that did not repeat on the road, or LA trailed and the 11-target Nacua game became the script. Pollard went over 60.5 because a +5.5 home dog stayed close, kept the 18-carry role, and LA's 4.22 YPC rush defense with three 10-plus runs already on file gave up one chunk run. The counter-case is strong enough that neither leg is better than a lean, and with no price the counter-case wins the decision not to bet.
